## Change

What changes and why? Agree scope-expanding features with the maintainer first.

## Verification

Commands run and results; state anything not tested.

- [ ] Relevant tests/checks run; limitations noted.
- [ ] No personal data, photos, backups, credentials or private configuration included.
- [ ] Migrations, translations and current-behavior documentation updated where needed.
- [ ] Dependency changes include regenerated `requirements.txt` and reviewed native notices.
